having a high probability; very likely

notes:
{濃厚|のうこう} describes intensity - either in taste/texture or in probability.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {濃|のう}: Thick, dense, concentrated
- {厚|こう}: Thick, heavy

FORMS:
- Attributive: {濃厚|のうこう}な + noun
- Predicate: {濃厚|のうこう}だ/⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧
- Adverbial: {濃厚|のうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧

SENSE 1 (TASTE/TEXTURE):
- Common with food descriptions
- Opposite of ⟦{淡泊|たんぱく}→淡泊：07906_tanpaku⟧ (light, plain)
- {濃厚|のうこう}な⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧, {濃厚|のうこう}な⟦ソース→ソース：17673_soosu⟧, {濃厚|のうこう}なチョコ

SENSE 2 (PROBABILITY):
- Common in news/formal contexts
- ⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{濃厚|のうこう} (strong possibility)
- ⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{濃厚|のうこう} (strong suspicion)

COVID-19 TERM:
- {濃厚|のうこう}{接触|せっしょく}(⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧) became widely used during the pandemic

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{希薄|きはく}→希薄：12473_kihaku⟧ (thin, weak - antonym)
- ⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧ (thick, strong - more casual)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in food descriptions and news.
